;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A car bomb explodes near a police post in [[Chabahar]], [[Iran]]. Two police officers are pronounced dead and around 40 people were wounded in the attack. Islamic militant group [[Ansar Al-Furqan]] claims responsibility. Iran accuses the perpetrators of being "foreign-backed terrorists". [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/bomb-attack-hits-southeast-iran-city-chabahar-1117591427 (Middle East Eye)]

;Arts and culture
*[[The Game Awards 2018]]
**[[God of War (2018 video game)|''God of War'']] is named [[List of Game of the Year awards|Game of the Year]] at [[The Game Awards]] annual awards ceremony in [[Los Angeles]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/gaming/news/game-awards-2018-winners-god-war-wins-game-year-red-dead-redemption/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two [[U.S. Marine]] aircraft from [[Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni|Iwakuni air base]] crash off the coast of [[Shikoku]], [[Japan]], during a [[mid-air refueling]]. One serviceman is rescued by Japan's [[Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force|Maritime Self-Defense Force]], while one is found dead and five are still reported missing. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/12/06/national/two-rescued-five-missing-mishap-involving-u-s-marine-tanker-fighter-jet-off-kochi/ (''The Japan Times'')]

;International relations
*A U.S.-sponsored resolution to condemn [[Hamas]] fails to get adopted at the [[United Nations General Assembly]]. [http://www.startribune.com/us-israel-and-palestinians-spar-over-condemning-hamas/502098651/ (AP via ''Minneapolis Star Tribune'')]

;Law and crime
*The [[Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] demands that [[Canada]] and the [[United States]] clarify the reasons behind the arrest of [[Huawei]] CFO [[Meng Wanzhou]], also asking for her immediate release. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/dec/05/meng-wanzhou-huawei-cfo-arrested-vancouver (''The Guardian'')]
*[[December 2018 Time Warner Center bomb threats]]
**[[CNN]] evacuates the [[Time Warner Center]] in New York City during ''[[CNN Tonight|CNN Tonight with Don Lemon]]'' after a bomb threat was called into the building. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/06/us/cnn-new-york-bomb-threat-evacuation/index.html (CNN)] [https://variety.com/2018/tv/news/cnn-new-york-evacuation-bomb-threat-1203083702/ (''Variety'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Afghan parliamentary election, 2018]]
**[[Afghanistan]]’s Electoral Complaints Commission declares all votes cast in [[Kabul Province]] to be invalid due to [[voter fraud]] and other cases of mismanagement. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-afghanistan-election/afghan-election-complaint-body-says-vote-in-capital-kabul-invalid-idUKKBN1O50X2 (Reuters)] 
*[[Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush]]
**Former U.S. President [[George H. W. Bush]] is laid to rest at [[George Bush Presidential Library|his Presidential Library]] in [[College Station, Texas]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/courage-warrior-george-h-w-bush-remember-family-friends-texas-n944806 (NBC News)]
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**The French police union Vigi calls on police officers to begin an indefinite strike on December 8 and join anti-government protesters, noting that "a majority of the French continue to back the movement". [https://sputniknews.com/europe/201812061070444941-french-police-union-calls-police-join-yellow-vests-protests/ (Sputnik News)]
**Major landmarks such as the [[Eiffel Tower]] and the [[Louvre]] are to shut down amid expected protests this weekend. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/06/french-government-warns-of-weekend-of-great-violence-protesters (''The Guardian'')]
